title: How to Organize a Speech or Presentation
skills: organize a speech or presentation with a clear beginning, middle, and end
sequence main points logically for audience comprehension
use transitions to connect ideas and sections

alignment_note: Explains how to organize a speech or presentation so ideas are clear, logical, and easy for an audience to follow. Supports public speaking, oral communication, presentation planning, transitions, audience awareness, and academic speaking across high school English courses.
